From: Alex Rivera <alex@brightlane.ai>

Date: Fri, 14 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Brightlane demo request (self-signup)

Hi Stephanie,

We just signed up for Redwood last night and poked around the hosted API. We'd like to schedule a short demo to understand performance at scale — primary use case is customer support triage (RAG + embeddings) and a second use case is semantic search over product docs.

Rough numbers: currently ~300k monthly queries with an expected ramp to ~2M queries/month in six months. We're evaluating throughput / cost tradeoffs (quantization + batching) and want to see a realistic demo of Dedicated and caching options.

Can you point me to a few times this week? Also, does Redwood provide a basic pre-demo checklist?

Thanks,
Alex Rivera
Head of Engineering, Brightlane AI
alex@brightlane.ai

Hi Alex — welcome and thanks for signing up. Happy to run a focused session. A couple quick questions so we tailor the demo to your needs: 

1) Which of the two use cases is highest priority for the pilot: support triage (RAG) or semantic search?
2) Can you share an expected concurrency profile (requests/sec or messages/sec) at 2M queries/month — e.g., average qps and a 95th percentile burst?
3) Data residency / SSO requirements? Any SOC2 / compliance checklist we should prep?
4) Timeline: when do you want pilot readiness (alpha) and target production launch month?

Propose three 45-min slots (PST):
- Mon 7/15 10:00–10:45am
- Mon 7/15 2:00–2:45pm
- Tue 7/16 9:00–9:45am

If none work, drop a few times for your team and I’ll sync with Ben to lock it. I’ve attached a brief pre-demo checklist (pre-demo-checklist.pdf) — it includes telemetry we’ll ask for and tokenization examples that help sizing. Calendar link: https://cal.com/stephanie/br-demo

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
SDR, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com

Thanks Stephanie — answers below inline.

On Fri, Jul 14, 2028 at 9:48 AM Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com> wrote:
> 1) Which of the two use cases is highest priority for the pilot: support triage (RAG) or semantic search?

Priority: support triage (RAG) — we will likely do search after pilot.

> 2) Can you share an expected concurrency profile (requests/sec or messages/sec) at 2M queries/month — e.g., average qps and a 95th percentile burst?

Estimate: 2M queries/month maps to ~0.8 qps average; peak bursts expected up to ~25 qps during business hours. Typical request payloads average ~1.2k tokens (prompt + context). We are planning a pilot with a subset of traffic (~10–15%) first.

> 3) Data residency / SSO requirements? Any SOC2 / compliance checklist we should prep?

We need: SOC2 evidence (if you have an FAQ), and SSO via Okta is required for pilot. We host no PHI.

> 4) Timeline: when do you want pilot readiness (alpha) and target production launch month?

Pilot readiness: target 6 weeks from now (tentative) — production: Q4.

Slots: Mon 7/15 10:00am PST works for me. Please confirm and we’ll include one engineer and our product manager.

Thanks,
Alex
Head of Engineering, Brightlane AI
